scope: Cambridge Part III General Relativity examinations 2013–2025 excluding 2020

problems.short_topic: Lie derivatives of general tensor fields and their commutator algebra
problems.disposition_rationale: A strong, self-contained tensor-analysis parent: it progresses from the flow definition through contraction, the Leibniz rule, component formulae, and the commutator identity. Any reuse must retain the adapted-coordinate allowance and every linked tensor-type calculation.

problems.short_topic: Quadrupole radiation from an equal-mass circular binary
problems.disposition_rationale: The question joins the harmonic-gauge retarded field, the slow-source quadrupole reduction, a fully specified equal-mass binary, and the astrophysical compactness conclusion. The position-vector hint and the nonrelativistic and far-zone assumptions are essential parts of the parent.

problems.short_topic: Metric variation and field equations of f(R) gravity
problems.disposition_rationale: This is a complete action-principle exercise, deriving the connection, Ricci tensor, and scalar variations before varying a general f(R) action and testing covariance, Lovelock applicability, and Einstein-space solutions. The supplied curvature convention, determinant identity, and hint must accompany all subparts.

problems.short_topic: Cartan connection and curvature forms for a planar asymptotically anti-de Sitter metric
problems.disposition_rationale: A compact but substantive tetrad-formalism parent with the metric, function f, and orthonormal coframe all supplied. Computing both structure equations and then verifying the Einstein equation with the correct cosmological constant makes it a good Chapter 12 exercise; the full coframe normalization is indispensable.

problems.short_topic: Pushforwards, pullbacks, hypersurface projection, and cylinder extrinsic curvature
problems.disposition_rationale: The abstract map operations are used immediately to prove hypersurface projection identities and then evaluated on a concrete embedded cylinder. The sign choice for the unit normal and extrinsic curvature, the embedding map, and the note about the second chart must be retained.

problems.short_topic: Relativistic units and quadrupole radiation from head-on infall
problems.disposition_rationale: A valuable dimensional and physical quadrupole problem that connects SI solar data to relativistic units, derives the Newtonian head-on orbit and third quadrupole derivative, and integrates the radiated energy. Equation (†), its z0 limit, and the stated z = 2m cutoff are linked dependencies and cannot be excerpted.

problems.short_topic: Time-symmetric conformally flat initial data and the Hamiltonian constraint
problems.disposition_rationale: After establishing the coordinate rules for pushforward and pullback, the parent reduces the vacuum 3+1 constraints for conformally flat, time-symmetric data to Laplace's equation and constructs an asymptotically flat nonconstant solution. The supplied curvature convention and both constraint equations are required context.

problems.short_topic: Newtonian geodesic limit and a Lagrangian for linearized gravity
problems.disposition_rationale: The full weak-field parent contrasts the quasistatic Newtonian limit with time-dependent linearized gravity, derives the linearized Einstein tensor, and verifies the quadratic spin-2 Lagrangian. Keeping the given metric ansätze, Ricci perturbation, and complete Lagrangian is necessary for a faithful exercise.

problems.short_topic: Equivalence of staticity and hypersurface-orthogonal timelike Killing symmetry
problems.disposition_rationale: A rigorous symmetry parent that constructs adapted coordinates, proves the stationary Killing criterion, and completes both directions of the staticity and hypersurface-orthogonality equivalence. Equation (†), the exponent determination, and the final coordinate transformation are one continuous argument.

problems.short_topic: Bianchi consistency, stress-tensor variation, and minimally coupled scalar matter
problems.disposition_rationale: The question coherently motivates Einstein's tensor, proves determinant and stress-tensor identities, and varies a complete scalar action to obtain both its equation and conserved energy-momentum tensor. The determinant derivative and boundary condition on the scalar variation are needed assumptions.

problems.short_topic: Harmonic coordinates, hyperbolic Einstein equations, and harmonic slicing in ADM form
problems.disposition_rationale: This strong formulation problem connects harmonic coordinate conditions to the principal wave operator in the vacuum equations and then derives harmonic slicing from the full lapse-shift ADM metric. The supplied ADM evolution equation, determinant relation, and globally hyperbolic setting must remain with the parent.

problems.short_topic: Connections with torsion and nonmetricity, exponential maps, and generalized normal coordinates
problems.disposition_rationale: Although mathematically sound and self-contained, most of the parent develops a general affine connection with both torsion and nonmetricity and a specialized normal-coordinate identity. Weinberg's chapter organization consistently centers the Levi-Civita connection, so preserving the whole parent would add substantial machinery with little payoff and splitting it is forbidden.

problems.short_topic: Electric and magnetic Weyl curvature in a 3+1 decomposition
problems.disposition_rationale: A high-value 3+1 parent deriving spatial Weyl data from the lapse, shift, volume forms, extrinsic curvature, and Gauss–Codazzi relations. The orientation convention, projector definitions, explicit Weyl formula, and both supplied Gauss–Codazzi equations are essential to determining all four constants.

problems.short_topic: Radial null geodesics and mass profiles in Vaidya spacetime
problems.disposition_rationale: The complete question derives coordinate geodesics, computes the Vaidya connection, identifies both radial null families, and solves for an accretion mass profile with controlled small-v asymptotics. Equation (†), the implicit v–w relation, and the n > 1 assumption must be preserved.

problems.short_topic: Composition of mixed tensors and Lie-derivative commutator and Jacobi identities
problems.disposition_rationale: This concise algebraic parent checks the multilinear meaning and component order of mixed-tensor composition before proving the Lie-derivative representation and its Jacobi identity on functions and vector fields. Both halves reinforce invariant tensor operations and should stay together.

problems.short_topic: Geodesic deviation, TT gravitational waves, detector response, and oscillator radiation
problems.disposition_rationale: An unusually complete gravitational-wave parent: it derives geodesic deviation, proves linearized curvature gauge invariance, evaluates TT plane-wave tidal motion, and closes with quadrupole power from an oscillating mass. The displayed polarization matrix and quadrupole definitions replace any need for an external figure and must be copied exactly.

problems.short_topic: Ellipsoid atlases, pushforwards, induced metrics, and conformal flattening
problems.disposition_rationale: The atlas construction and pushforward definitions culminate in a concrete induced metric and an explicit conformal flattening of a two-dimensional ellipsoid patch. It is a useful geometry exercise for tensor analysis, provided the full defining quadric, coordinate domain, and nonzero conformal factor requirement remain intact.

problems.short_topic: Newtonian limits of relativistic connections and geometrization of force laws
problems.disposition_rationale: This parent gives a geometric view of the Newtonian limit: it compares geodesic Lagrangians, takes a controlled c → infinity connection limit, recovers Laplace's equation, and represents electric and magnetic force trajectories by a torsion-free spacetime connection. The c-dependent exponential metric and unparametrized-geodesic qualification are essential.

problems.short_topic: Cartan's Lie-derivative formula, flows, volume scaling, and charged-particle symmetry
problems.disposition_rationale: A coherent forms-and-flows exercise proving Cartan's identity, checking it on explicit rotational and dilation fields, and applying invariant Maxwell data to a charged-particle conserved quantity. The explicit X, Y, one-form, volume form, and Lorentz-force equation make it self-contained despite the allowance to use lecture results.

problems.short_topic: Exact polarized plane-wave metrics in Cartan's formalism
problems.disposition_rationale: The specified null-dependent orthonormal coframe leads through connection and curvature forms to the exact vacuum condition, followed by the linearized interpretation as plus polarization. The functions A and B, their nonvanishing assumption, and the final linearization hint are inseparable parts of the exercise.

problems.short_topic: Real projective-space atlas and scalar curvature of a quotient-induced metric
problems.disposition_rationale: The complete parent is an abstract Riemannian-geometry exercise on the topology of real projective space and a specially chosen quotient metric. Its conformal-curvature calculation is valid, but the projective-space construction has no direct gravitation application in Weinberg's Chapters 2–16 and cannot be removed without truncating the parent.

problems.short_topic: Killing-vector integrability, conserved geodesic quantities, and Euclidean isometries
problems.disposition_rationale: The parent derives a curvature identity and the Killing-vector integrability equation, obtains the associated geodesic constant, classifies all Euclidean Killing fields, and integrates a translation-plus-rotation example. The normal-coordinate hint and the general constants A and M are needed to preserve its progression.

problems.short_topic: Quadrupole radiation from a rotating triaxial rigid body
problems.disposition_rationale: A complete source-to-waveform problem deriving the far-zone quadrupole field, transforming a body's principal quadrupole under rigid rotation, and obtaining both emitted frequency and average power. The diagonal rest-frame tensor and explicit rotation-matrix dependence distinguish it from binary-source questions.

problems.short_topic: Metric variations and the stress tensor of a curvature-coupled scalar field
problems.disposition_rationale: The question derives every metric-variation ingredient and uses it to obtain and prove conservation of the improved stress tensor for a nonminimally coupled scalar. The curvature convention, coupling ξ, and all boundary-term coefficients are central and should be audited carefully under Weinberg's action notation.

problems.short_topic: Derivation of the quadrupole power formula and circular star–planet radiation
problems.disposition_rationale: Unlike source questions that assume the power formula, this parent asks for its derivation from the inhomogeneous linearized wave equation and then applies it to an unequal-mass circular orbit. The trace-reversed source term, quadrupole normalization, averaging, and orbital period data must all be retained.

problems.short_topic: Cartan curvature of de Sitter space in flat cosmological slicing
problems.disposition_rationale: A focused exact-space exercise constructing an orthonormal coframe and both Cartan forms for an exponential-scale-factor metric, then deriving its nonzero cosmological constant. It is a compact maximally symmetric-space calculation and remains distinct from the separate question sharing printed page 2.

problems.short_topic: Timelike geodesics and periodic radial motion in anti-de Sitter space
problems.disposition_rationale: The parent combines the geodesic action, full equations, a careful spherical-symmetry reduction, Killing constants, the radial effective equation, and the universal return time in anti-de Sitter space. Its requested symmetry diagram is student-produced, so no source figure is missing, but that diagram instruction must remain.

problems.short_topic: Einstein–Proca field equations and Bianchi consistency from an action
problems.disposition_rationale: This full action-principle parent derives both Bianchi identities, varies the Einstein–Proca action with respect to metric and vector, proves the massive divergence constraint and field-strength identity, and checks mutual consistency. The supplied linear Ricci-scalar variation and target Einstein equation are deliberate scaffolding, not removable hints.

problems.short_topic: Lie derivatives and the transitive Killing symmetries of a nonlinear plane wave
problems.disposition_rationale: The Lie-derivative preliminaries directly support solving Killing's equation for a nonlinear gravitational plane wave and proving transitivity on each constant-u surface. The smooth profile a(u), the two separate two-parameter Killing families, and the final isometry construction form one symmetry problem.

problems.short_topic: Newtonian weak-field limit and multipolar gravitational radiation from a supernova
problems.disposition_rationale: This parent carefully fixes post-Newtonian orders, recovers both the test-body and Poisson limits, and then applies the radiative quadrupole machinery to a symmetric-tracefree spherical-harmonic expansion of a supernova. The ordering assumptions and isotropic-Cartesian-tensor allowance are required to isolate the radiating multipoles.

problems.short_topic: Kasner spacetime curvature and its vacuum exponent constraints
problems.disposition_rationale: A clean anisotropic-cosmology parent that builds the orthonormal frame, connection, curvature, Riemann and Ricci tensors and derives both Kasner exponent conditions. The explicit warning that spatial indices are not summed is crucial and must survive notation conversion.

problems.short_topic: Metric variation and Einstein–Maxwell–dilaton equations with the null energy condition
problems.disposition_rationale: The question derives the gravitational boundary variation and then varies a fully specified scalar–Maxwell action, computes its stress tensor, and proves the null energy condition. It shares printed page 4 with Question 3 but is a separate complete parent; the exponential coupling and F = dA definition are essential.

problems.short_topic: Geodetic precession of an orbiting gyroscope in Schwarzschild spacetime
problems.disposition_rationale: A complete exact derivation of de Sitter geodetic precession from parallel transport on a circular Schwarzschild orbit. The initial radial spin direction, orthogonality to the four-velocity, R > 3M restriction, intermediate frequency, normalization argument, and final accumulated angle are one indivisible calculation.

problems.short_topic: Form-field stress tensors, diffeomorphism identities, and totally geodesic hypersurfaces
problems.disposition_rationale: Both halves are worthwhile, but the source parent combines an unrelated 3-form and covector-action Noether calculation with a separate timelike-hypersurface theorem about extrinsic curvature. No single Weinberg chapter can host the complete parent naturally, and selecting either half would violate the indivisible-parent rule.

problems.short_topic: Waveform, polarization, and power from a rotating thin rod
problems.disposition_rationale: The parent begins with the retarded solution and derives both spatial and mixed far-zone components before treating a fully specified rotating rod, its frequency, on-axis plus/cross polarization, and average power. The delta-function line density and supplied h00 approximation are necessary source data.

problems.short_topic: Three-dimensional Gödel spacetime: curvature, dust source, and homogeneous isometries
problems.disposition_rationale: Although explicitly three-dimensional, this is a self-contained model problem on Gödel-type cosmology: it verifies a coframe, computes Cartan curvature, identifies the dust and cosmological constant, and proves homogeneity. Reuse must state the dimensional limitation prominently rather than silently converting it to four dimensions.

problems.short_topic: Isotropic curvature, Bianchi identities, and geodesic deviation in constant-curvature spacetime
problems.disposition_rationale: This broad but unified constant-curvature parent derives the Riemann and Bianchi machinery, proves constancy of isotropic curvature, and solves geodesic deviation in a parallel frame for all signs of K. The normal-coordinate allowance, initial data, and first-order approximation are essential.

problems.short_topic: Klein–Gordon stress tensor, Killing current, and conserved energy on a static spacetime
problems.disposition_rationale: The metric and scalar variations lead directly to a conserved stress tensor and Killing current, then to an explicit positive conserved energy on a general static background. The compact-support or decay condition and the exact lapse and spatial-volume factors must be kept for the divergence-theorem argument.

problems.short_topic: Linearized field of a slowly rotating axisymmetric star and frame dragging
problems.disposition_rationale: A strong post-Newtonian parent deriving wave-gauge linearized Einstein equations, imposing stress-energy conservation on a rigidly rotating dust star, and extracting both mass and spin terms of the exterior metric. The neglected orders, integral solutions, Poisson kernel, and definition of the rotation parameter a must remain explicit.

problems.short_topic: Perfect-fluid conservation and the Einstein static universe on a three-sphere
problems.disposition_rationale: The question derives relativistic fluid evolution, develops the Euler-angle coframe of S3, computes the product-spacetime curvature, and determines the homogeneous fluid and cosmological constant, including the dust specialization. The angle ranges, Maurer–Cartan normalization, and supplied Cartan equations fix important numerical factors.

problems.short_topic: Timelike variational principle and displacement and velocity memory from a plane-wave pulse
problems.disposition_rationale: This complete gravitational-memory problem first derives the proper-time and affine geodesic actions, then follows a test mass through a compact plane-wave pulse to obtain both displacement and velocity memory and the deformation of a ring. The profile support, perturbative order, integral identity, and requested before-and-after sketches are indispensable.

problems.short_topic: Maxwell dominant energy and a conformal-vector monotonicity estimate on Minkowski space
problems.disposition_rationale: The parent is primarily a geometric PDE energy-estimate problem for the vacuum Maxwell system: after standard stress-tensor identities it constructs a radial multiplier and proves a monotonic integral on unbounded Minkowski slices. That analytic multiplier method is not part of Weinberg's gravitation organization, and retaining only the preliminary energy conditions would truncate the source.

problems.short_topic: f(R) field equations and their weak-field agreement with general relativity
problems.disposition_rationale: The parent derives the metric boundary terms, varies a general f(R) action, verifies Minkowski space, and under precise conditions proves equality with linearized Einstein theory in wave gauge. The assumptions f(0) = 0, f′(0) = 1, f″(0) = 0 and the supplied Ricci formula materially determine the conclusion.

problems.short_topic: Schwarzschild curvature and tidal destruction in Painlevé–Gullstrand coordinates
problems.disposition_rationale: A well-scaffolded exact Schwarzschild problem that verifies the regular infalling coframe, computes both Cartan forms, proves a useful diagonal-curvature lemma, obtains the vacuum Ricci tensor, and interprets the divergent tidal curvature through geodesic deviation. The Painlevé–Gullstrand cross term and supplied tetrad must be transcribed exactly.

problems.short_topic: Radial timelike and null geodesics in anti-de Sitter spacetime
problems.disposition_rationale: This anti-de Sitter parent starts from global Cartesian coordinates, derives the static spherical form and Christoffel symbols, identifies the radial first integral, and contrasts periodic timelike motion with null arrival at conformal infinity in finite coordinate time. Its null-geodesic conclusion and coordinate conversion make it substantively broader than the 2019 AdS parent.

problems.short_topic: Penrose wave equation for curvature and its gauge-invariant linearization
problems.disposition_rationale: The parent derives the Riemann and Bianchi identities, fixes the coefficient in a supplied nonlinear curvature identity, obtains the vacuum curvature wave equation, and linearizes it about Minkowski space to expose gauge independence. The full identity (∗) is a necessary supplied result and must not be summarized away.

problems.short_topic: Linearized vacuum gravity, residual gauge freedom, and transverse-traceless plane waves
problems.disposition_rationale: A complete derivation of wave-gauge linearized Einstein theory that characterizes residual gauge transformations and explicitly reduces a localized plane-wave ansatz to its two TT polarizations. The decay condition, null wave vector, supplied coordinate-gauge hints, and arbitrary plus and cross profiles are all required for a reproducible solution.

problems.short_topic: Exterior and Lie derivatives, conformal Killing fields, and Maxwell symmetry
problems.disposition_rationale: The parent develops coordinate-independent exterior differentiation and flow-defined Lie derivatives, characterizes conformal Killing fields through preservation of the mixed-index volume tensor, and proves that their Lie action maps vacuum Maxwell solutions to solutions. The supplied epsilon contractions and precise index placement are essential to determining the conformal coefficient.
